intro: From morning mess to nighttime calm, our Upmods Perch bed keeps it together. Rich finish, full storage, and sturdy build help you declutter and reset—every single night.

features.title: Engineered for everyday strength
features.text: Our engineered wood frame gives you dependable support and structure, crafted to last through daily use.

features.title: Storage that stays unseen
features.text: A full hydraulic lift reveals ample space for linens, clothes, and seasonal storage—without taking up extra room. And with multiple storage options available, you can choose what works best for your home and lifestyle.

features.title: We bring warmth to your room
features.text: Perch's sleek, minimalist design with a unique geometric groove detail on the headboard adds texture and depth, making it a standout piece, effortlessly elevating your space.

features.title: Designed to ground your space
features.text: With its tall rectangular headboard and matte finish, our thoughtfully-designed becomes a quiet centrepiece in your room.

features.title: Easy to clean, easy to keep
features.text: The anti-scratch PU coating makes maintenance quick—no effort, no stains, just more time for rest.

name: Upmods Perch Cream King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Eco Lift Up Hydraulic Storage
